title: Louisville trip, Dreamland Cafe and George Mitchell
summary: Wickliffe's band plays a month in Louisville and returns to Dreamland, with George Mitchell on trumpet. They chat about Mitchell today.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
